test_title: PYST 4: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 02 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in passive voice.**

The Governor of the state inaugurated the exhibition in a grand way.

options.text: The exhibition had been inaugurated by the Governor of the state in a grand way.
The exhibition inaugurated by the Governor of the state in a grand way.
The exhibition has been inaugurated by the Governor of the state in a grand way.
The exhibition was inaugurated by the Governor of the state in a grand way.

solution:
The correct answer is: **The exhibition was inaugurated by the Governor of the state in a grand way.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In an **active voice** sentence, the subject performs the action.
 
• The basic **structure **is Subject + Verb + Object__.
